entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want their heads, Lucian.""
entries.dialogueText: "I want their heads, Lucian."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mrs. Morgna's task force suspected..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mrs. Morgna's task force suspected Old Guard members of multiple cases of corruption and lobbying. But when they looked deeper into it, they found something truly shocking."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The Old Guard led by Hawker and Gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Old Guard led by Hawker and Graf -- with the suspected approval of Tarquin Soll -- organized the assassination of Bernard Circas."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The main co-conspirators were Orso..."
entries.dialogueText: "The main co-conspirators were Orso Hawker and Lileas Graf."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're joking.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're joking."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What? But why?""
entries.dialogueText: "What? But why?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I always thought they were involve..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always thought they were involved."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Since you took office, their goal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since you took office, their goal was to protect Soll and his constitution. They needed an event extreme enough to distract you from making reforms."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, they didn't succeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, they didn't succeed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who was involved in this?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who was involved in this?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That may be complicated. Because w..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be complicated. Because we found out about another piece of information."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, when that didn't work,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, when that didn't work, they had other ways of impeding you."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And they succeeded.""
entries.dialogueText: "And they succeeded."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As you may recall, Karl Greiser hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you may recall, Karl Greiser hinted at a 'complex web of connections' surrounding the Old Guard as well as multiple cases of corruption and lobbying."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""However, he kept stalling whenever..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, he kept stalling whenever I pressed him for details."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As did his successor after he was..."
entries.dialogueText: "As did his successor after he was fired."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Eventually, I received this bullet..."
entries.dialogueText: "Eventually, I received this bulletin from the desk of the Secret State Police. Supposedly a list of leads they'd uncovered."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He handed me a sheet of paper. On i..."
entries.dialogueText: He handed me a sheet of paper. On it was a short list of names.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Look at the first letter of each n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at the first letter of each name."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I went down the list. It spelled "N..."
entries.dialogueText: I went down the list. It spelled "NICE TRY GALADE.'"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Cute.""
entries.dialogueText: "Cute."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So they're playing with us?""
entries.dialogueText: "So they're playing with us?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What is the meaning of this?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is the meaning of this?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Lileas and the Old Guard undoubted..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lileas and the Old Guard undoubtedly have something to hide. But the Secret State Police is their instrument."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian smiled wryly."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian smiled wryly.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Frankly, sir, you asking them to i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, sir, you asking them to investigate their own bosses was a waste of both your time and mine."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I should have advised you not to p..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should have advised you not to pursue this. Sorry to have failed you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was my fault, not yours.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was my fault, not yours."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I realize that now. I'm sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "I realize that now. I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can't we still fire Lileas?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can't we still fire Lileas?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Apology accepted.""
entries.dialogueText: "Apology accepted."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""If you wish, you could still remov..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you wish, you could still remove Lileas from her cabinet position for encouraging the police's insubordination. But it wouldn't make you very popular."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ms. Graf has caused me nothing but..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Graf has caused me nothing but grief. Let's get rid of her."
entries.menuText: "Ms. Graf has caused me nothing but grief. Let's get rid of her."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're right. Can't be rocking the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. Can't be rocking the boat this close to the election."
entries.menuText: "You're right. Can't be rocking the boat this close to the election."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian swallowed."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian swallowed.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It may take some time to fire her..."
entries.dialogueText: "It may take some time to fire her without harming your election chances. But I'll get the process started."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And then there are the dozens of A..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then there are the dozens of Assembly members and thousands of government officials who may have been aware of the assassination plot and helped cover it up."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The main conspirator was Lileas Gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The main conspirator was Lileas Graf."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And then there are the dozens of A..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then there are the dozens of Assembly members and thousands of government officials who may have been aware of the assassination plot and helped cover it up."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will get rid of every single on..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will get rid of every single one that was involved in this plot."
entries.menuText: "We will get rid of every single one that was involved in this plot."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It would cause ripples if we got r..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would cause ripples if we got rid of everyone at once. We will start with Orso and Lileas."
entries.menuText: "It would cause ripples if we got rid of everyone at once. We will start with Orso and Lileas."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lileas Graf will be our primary ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lileas Graf will be our primary target. It's time she left politics. Once and for all."
entries.menuText: "Lileas Graf will be our primary target. It's time she left politics. Once and for all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Orso Hawker should be our primary..."
entries.dialogueText: "Orso Hawker should be our primary target. He is too dangerous keep around."
entries.menuText: "Orso Hawker should be our primary target. He is too dangerous keep around."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will get rid of every single on..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will get rid of every single one that was involved in this plot."
entries.menuText: "We will get rid of every single one that was involved in this plot."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lileas Graf will be our primary ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lileas Graf will be our primary target. It's time she left politics. Once and for all."
entries.menuText: "Lileas Graf will be our primary target. It's time she left politics. Once and for all."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That could end up being the larges..."
entries.dialogueText: "That could end up being the largest government purge in Sordland's history. Are you sure?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. The Old Guard has been a tain..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. The Old Guard has been a taint on my administration for far too long."
entries.menuText: "Yes. The Old Guard has been a taint on my government for far too long."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I meant, let's get rid of all the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I meant, let's get rid of all the main conspirators we can touch. No need to shake up the entire government so close to the election."
entries.menuText: "I meant, let's get rid of all the main conspirators we can touch. No need to shake up the entire government so close to the election."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That could end up being the larges..."
entries.dialogueText: "That could end up being the largest government purge in Sordland's history. Are you sure?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. The Old Guard has been a tain..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. The Old Guard has been a taint on my administration for far too long."
entries.menuText: "Yes. The Old Guard has been a taint on my government for far too long."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I meant, let's get rid of the main..."
entries.dialogueText: "I meant, let's get rid of the main conspirator we can touch. No need to shake up the entire government so close to the election."
entries.menuText: "I meant, let's get rid of the main conspirator we can touch. No need to shake up the entire government so close to the election."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""All right, sir. I'll get to work o..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right, sir. I'll get to work on it when we return to Holsord."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Further evidence suggests that the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Further evidence suggests that they orchestrated the destruction of the Holsord State University archives. We found out their motive was to destroy the employee records and proof regarding all the informants they secretly employed at the university from 1930 until 1953."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""To imagine that this is the extent..."
entries.dialogueText: "To imagine that this is the extent of our knowledge on their actions is deeply troubling. The chaos they created and the loss of life occurred because of them is treachery at the highest level and must not go unpunished in my opinion."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are there any other things they ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are there any other things they have done?"
entries.menuText: "Are there any other things they have done?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who is the main culprit?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who is the main culprit?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must act against this treachery.""
entries.dialogueText: "We must act against this treachery."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It would cause ripples if we got r..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would cause ripples if we got rid of everyone at once. We will start with Lileas."
